svg.title: Planchette glide profiles and the queue pacing rule
svg.desc: Position and speed of four glide models, and the equilibrium queue and skip rate of the ouija pacing rule.
svg.text: Ouija: one glide, four models; and the pacing rule under load
c: equilibrium queued lines q* = L * lam - 4, capped at 8; above lam = 12 / L lines per second the excess is skipped and counted
